test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, SQUARE is coded as RP51Q2 and CUBE is coded as B5A2. How will TRIANGLE be coded in the same language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d66aed56b0110252d284b32d4106ded602a43d3c1fffe211225d3138e32a5069.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41aa04ea044be9f5af101dfb9d655fc43958d402f27cb73f6b7365b5ee00b200.png] 

 
• **Consonants are decreases - 1.**
 
• **Vowels alphabets order value is represented.**

SQUARE is coded as RP51Q2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa8acd1660b0a96258106a1efcda39fbf1a0d86c81cb415ad91cc7cb4bdc7c31.png] 

And,

CUBE is coded as B5A2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/237419ba00d9bc744824f393dd609a1ab876ae5749c052605aa581fa45321f71.png] 

Similarly,

 
• **TRIANGLE will be coded as :**

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48a313d5cc0c526f1bdeb8118ddfff3309b03fa5a721581a2bd963f6a94c1df9.png] **

Hence, the correct answer is **"SQ31MFK2".**
